GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG370.05 (19 Jan 46) GC
(SCAPIN-627)
APO 500
19 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of lepers.
1. This headquarters is in receipt of information that lepers are being repatriated from Japan to Korea.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will not repatriate lepers.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A. G. D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
